$schema: Fields written and read by the Hersham Village Market page and the Thursday status-check routine (hersham-village-market-status). Same shape as apps-court-status.json so EventStatusPanel can be reused. status is only ever 'on' or 'off' for a date the market itself has stated in a post or Facebook event; otherwise 'unconfirmed'. lastCheckSucceeded=false means the previous check could not confidently read the sources: the rest of this file was deliberately left untouched rather than overwritten with a guess.
headline: Not yet confirmed for Friday 16 October
detail: The market has not yet posted about Friday 16 October. It usually creates a Facebook event a few days ahead, so check its Facebook page before you set off.
